effectiveCondition: Effective only after owner-reviewed merge to main, one exact successful four-job post-merge release-gate push run, and execution from tracked-clean main equal to freshly fetched origin/main.

approvalAuthority.requestBasis: The repository owner explicitly approved governed Build 8 backend deployment and ADB verification without clearing phone data. The backend subsequently produced PASS_BUILD8_F4_BACKEND_READY, and the exact finalized Build 8 remains installed on the bound phone with its approved session preserved.

authorizedSequence: verify exact merged promotion, Build 8 finalization evidence, backend-readiness evidence and one successful four-job post-merge release-gate run
verify the governed package, embedded APK, production signer, remote built tag, bound physical target and currently installed APK
verify the existing approved session can reach the role-appropriate Home surface without a forbidden authentication or authority marker
capture privacy-minimized local diagnostics and stop unless pending local business writes are zero
trigger one ordinary in-app manual sync over the current network state
require the explicit Manual sync completed marker and a post-run local diagnostics count of zero pending writes
write one append-only privacy-minimized receipt outside the repository
prohibitedOperations: install, reinstall, downgrade, uninstall or clear application data
change Wi-Fi, mobile-data, airplane-mode, proxy or traffic-shaping state
sign in, sign out, select an account or alter the approved user profile
create, edit, close, approve, revoke or delete business records
deploy Firebase resources, mutate IAM, enable App Check or change indexes
retain raw UI XML, ADB serial, build fingerprint, Android ID, account identity, Firebase uid, token or business payload
close STAGE2D-F4 or P-07, authorize pilot handout or distribute Build 8 from this one sync receipt
expiresWhen: The merged promotion, bound evidence, Build 8 artifact, target hashes, installed APK, approved session or backend-ready state differs, or a sync-retry receipt already exists for this approval.
